overview_limits: Upload limit: {limit} per file · Voice channels {voice}.
account_creation_request: By request: staff approve new accounts
max_upload_hint: Per file. Files are stored in the server's data folder.
voice_channels_hint: A preview: people can join voice channels and see who's there, but audio isn't available yet.
feature_profile_banner_hint: An image at the top of your profile.
feature_profile_colors_hint: Two colours that tint the whole profile card.
feature_animated_media_hint: GIF / animated WebP avatars, guild icons, banners and role icons play instead of standing still.
feature_guild_banner_hint: An image at the top of a guild's channel list and on its invites.
feature_gradient_roles_hint: Role names in a gradient of two or three colours.
feature_role_icons_hint: A small image or emoji next to members' names.
feature_client_themes_hint: Colour presets and custom gradient backgrounds for the app.
mode_on_hint: Every account can use the features switched on below.
mode_allowlist_hint: Only people given perks by an admin (and server staff). Like handing out Nitro.
mode_off_hint: Customisation is off. Stored banners and colours are kept but hidden.
owner_only_note: Only the server owner can change these.
customization_intro: Custom emoji and stickers are always available to everyone. These extras can be limited.
allowlist_active_hint: These people can customise. Server staff always can.
allowlist_inactive_hint: Only used in allow-list mode. You can prepare it now.
legal_intro: Markdown. People see these before creating an account, and existing members are asked to accept them again whenever you change them. Leave both empty to turn this off.
privacy_placeholder:
# Privacy

What this server stores and who can see it.
legal_saved_toast: {label} saved — members will be asked to accept it
ip_visibility_note: IP addresses are visible to server staff only.
disable_confirm_message: They're logged out everywhere and can't log in until re-enabled.
ban_devices_message: Blocks every browser they've logged in from on this server. It's easy to get around (clearing site data), so pair it with an IP ban for raids.
no_known_ip_toast: No known IP address for them
ban_ip_message: Everyone connecting from {ip} is disconnected and blocked, not just {name}.
reset_password_message: They'll be logged out everywhere. You'll see the new password once.
new_password_subtitle: Give this to {name}. It won't be shown again.
mute_dialog_subtitle: They can still read, but can't send messages, react, upload or join voice anywhere on the server — including DMs.
reason_audit_label: Reason (optional, shown in the audit log)
delete_account_message: Their messages stay but show as “Deleted User”. Their avatar and uploads are deleted, guilds they own pass to their highest-ranked member, and the username becomes free. This can't be undone.
staff_intro: Moderators can approve and disable accounts, mute people server-wide and ban IPs and devices. Admins can also delete accounts, reset passwords and manage every guild. Only the server owner changes server settings and appoints admins.
ip_bans_intro: Banned addresses can't connect at all. Use a range (/24) for people who hop between nearby addresses.
device_bans_intro: Added from an account's Manage menu. A device ban only stops that browser profile; clearing site data gets around it.
guilds_intro: Every guild on this server. A ghost join lets you read a guild without its members seeing you; you can't post.
delete_guild_message: Every channel, message and role in it is deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.
